title: Epic: uSEQ modular refactor for testable bounded components
description:
## Goal
Refactor uSEQ toward simpler, maintainable, testable modules by breaking monolithic components into bounded contexts and explicit interfaces.

## Why this exists
Analysis found high-risk concentration in a few large files with mixed concerns, hidden globals, and platform conditionals that make reasoning/testing difficult.

### Hotspot inventory (non-vendored)
- `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/modulisp/lisp/builtins.cpp` (~2795 LOC)
- `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/modulisp/modulisp_api.cpp` (~2314 LOC)
- `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/uSEQ.cpp` (~1736 LOC)
- `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/modulisp/lisp/value.cpp` (~1574 LOC)
- `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/uSEQ/io_manager.cpp` (~1014 LOC)

### Module totals (approx)
- `uSEQ/src/modulisp`: ~11,954 LOC
- `uSEQ/src/dsp`: ~4,260 LOC
- `uSEQ/src/uSEQ`: ~2,817 LOC
- `uSEQ/src/utils`: ~2,757 LOC

## Strategic seams to establish
1. Runtime orchestration: split routing/eval/persistence/hardware.
2. ModuLisp API/builtins: split by domain and normalize validation.
3. Value/parser/environment: isolate data model and policy.
4. Hardware/platform: board profiles + adapter interfaces.
5. Persistence and transport: strategy-based backends.

## Known risk notes
- Suspected stale member usage in desktop persistence path: `m_def_exprs` references in `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/uSEQ_flash.cpp` appear inconsistent with current API.
- Suspected arg usage bug in `ard_lerp` in `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/modulisp/lisp/builtins.cpp`.

## Success criteria
- No behavior regressions across current tests plus added refactor coverage.
- Critical monolith files are reduced and responsibilities partitioned.
- Clear interfaces enable isolated unit tests for parsing, builtins, routing, and output evaluation.
- Platform-specific behavior is contained in adapters/profile classes.

## First three low-risk PR targets
1. Builtin argument-validation helper extraction.
2. `IProgramStore` and persistence split.
3. `CommandRouter` extraction from `uSEQ.cpp`.

title: Create baseline architecture map and dependency contract
description:
## Objective
Create a baseline architecture map and decomposition contract to keep all follow-on refactors coherent.

## Scope
- Produce bounded-context map for Runtime, ModuLisp core, Builtins/API, Persistence, Transport, Hardware IO.
- Identify current ownership boundaries in:
  - `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/uSEQ.cpp`
  - `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/uSEQ_api.cpp`
  - `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/uSEQ_update.cpp`
  - `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/modulisp/modulisp_api.cpp`
  - `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/modulisp/lisp/builtins.cpp`
  - `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/uSEQ/io_manager.cpp`
- Define interface ownership and dependency direction (what is allowed to call what).

## Deliverables
- Architecture decision record(s) with dependency rules.
- Refactor checklist for all subtasks in this epic.
- Baseline hotspot metrics recorded for before/after comparison.

## Acceptance
- Future subtasks can cite this document as contract.
- Dependency boundaries are explicit and test implications are documented.

title: Split lisp builtins.cpp into domain modules with stable registration
description:
## Objective
Decompose builtins monolith by domain while preserving semantics.

## Scope
- Split `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/modulisp/lisp/builtins.cpp` into domain modules, e.g.:
  - core predicates/logic
  - list operations
  - arithmetic/math
  - random/time helpers
  - hardware-bound helpers (if any)
- Keep registration wiring stable and readable.

## Deliverables
- Domain-specific source files + clear registration map.
- Table-driven tests for representative builtins from each domain.

## Acceptance
- No functional regressions.
- `builtins.cpp` monolith meaningfully reduced.

title: Split modulisp_api.cpp by domain and remove duplicated implementations
description:
## Objective
Decompose `modulisp_api.cpp` into coherent API domains and eliminate duplicate implementations.

## Scope
- Split `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/modulisp/modulisp_api.cpp` into smaller modules:
  - output assignment/eval APIs
  - timing/phasor transforms
  - sequence/pattern generation
  - scheduler APIs
- Consolidate duplicate behavior noted during analysis (e.g., similar seq/list conversion paths).

## Acceptance
- API registration and behavior stay stable.
- Shared helpers eliminate repeated arg/type boilerplate.
- Domain modules are individually testable.

title: Decompose Value model (value.cpp) into core + signal metadata policies
description:
## Objective
Break `value.cpp` into smaller data-model units and isolate signal metadata policy.

## Scope

  - core value representation
  - arithmetic/comparison behavior
  - serialization/display behavior
  - signal metadata propagation policy
- Reduce cross-cutting side effects in primitive operations.

## Acceptance
- Value operations become easier to reason about and unit test.
- Signal metadata handling is explicit and isolated.

title: Clean parser/environment APIs and remove duplicate wrapper paths
description:
## Objective
Reduce parser/environment coupling and remove legacy wrapper paths that duplicate parser behavior.

## Scope

## Acceptance

- Environment lookup behavior is testable independently of UI/error emission policy.

title: Remove global/static interpreter state via explicit dependency injection
description:
## Objective
Remove hidden global interpreter coupling and move to explicit dependency injection.

## Scope

- Reduced hidden cross-test coupling/order dependence.

title: Unify timing/phasor ownership across modulisp_time and phasor_manager
description:

title: Refactor I2C host/client layer to remove extern-global state
description:

- Align behavior with transport seam introduced in runtime.
- Preserve desktop stub and hardware behavior parity.

## Acceptance
- Reduced global mutable state.
- I2C behavior can be tested through interface contracts.

title: Targeted builtin correctness audit (ard_lerp + diagnostics consistency)
description:
## Objective

title: Integration hardening: remove dead paths, update docs, and closeout metrics
description:
## Objective

## Scope

- Summarize before/after metrics and remaining debt.

## Acceptance

title: Expand refactor safety test harnesses before major extraction
description:
## Objective
Expand/refine tests that protect refactors from behavior regressions.

## Scope
- Audit existing meson tests in `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/test/meson.build`.
- Add focused harnesses for:
  - parser/value/environment behavior
  - builtin argument/type error handling
  - routing and protocol decoding
  - output evaluation consistency
- Add golden/table-driven tests where high duplication exists today.

## Deliverables
- New or improved test targets and fixtures.
- Short matrix of what each test suite protects during module extraction.

## Acceptance
- At least one isolation test per planned seam.
- CI/local test path documented for future agents.

title: Introduce runtime interfaces and delegation seams (no behavior change)
description:
## Objective
Introduce explicit runtime seams with interfaces and delegation wrappers, without behavior changes.

## Scope
- Add interfaces (names may vary):
  - `IProgramStore`
  - `ITransport`
  - `IOutputEvaluator`
  - `IHardwareFacade` (or equivalent)

- Keep old entry points temporarily for compatibility.

## Primary files

- `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/uSEQ.cpp`

title: Extract CommandRouter from uSEQ.cpp (serial/JSON dispatch isolation)
description:
## Objective
Extract request parsing/dispatch from the `uSEQ` god-object into a dedicated command router.

## Scope
- Move serial/JSON request parsing and dispatching from `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/uSEQ.cpp` to `CommandRouter`.
- Include functions currently coupled to routing flow (e.g., JSON field extraction and request parse logic).
- Keep runtime tick/update loop separate from transport command concerns.

## Deliverables
- New router module + tests for valid/invalid payloads.
- Thin integration from `uSEQ` to router.

## Acceptance
- Router can be tested without hardware.
- `uSEQ.cpp` responsibility narrows to lifecycle/tick orchestration.

title: Extract output evaluation service from uSEQ_update.cpp
description:
## Objective

## Scope
- Decompose duplicated output-type paths in `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/uSEQ_update.cpp`.
- Consolidate shared error handling and state mutation logic.
- Keep output writing separate from expression evaluation.

## Deliverables
- `OutputEvalService` (or equivalent) with deterministic tests.
- Reduced duplication across continuous/binary/serial output evaluation paths.

## Acceptance

title: Refactor persistence into ProgramStore adapters and resolve flash-path inconsistency
description:
## Objective
Split persistence concerns into platform-specific strategies and validate suspected desktop-path issue.

## Scope
- Extract persistence behind `IProgramStore` strategy.
- Separate Arduino flash implementation from desktop file storage implementation.
- Investigate and resolve inconsistent member usage notes around `m_def_exprs` in `/home/w1n5t0n/src/uSEQ/uSEQ/src/uSEQ_flash.cpp`.

## Deliverables

- Regression tests for save/load/default expression state.
- Documented root cause/resolution of `m_def_exprs` inconsistency.

## Acceptance
- Flash/file code no longer mixed in one monolith with deep `#ifdef` branching.
- Desktop and hardware paths are independently testable.
